resources.string: Manager only. Log in with an administrator account to export the data.
Insert the USB stick or SD card.
Choose the folder of the stick or card that will receive the exports. Create a folder named PILI-EXPORT there, then choose it.
The export copies the database, the backups, the logs and the identity of the till, then reads back and checks every file.
Export running. Do not remove the stick or card.
You can remove the stick or card. To check the export: shasum -a 256 -c MANIFEST.sha256
The files already written are kept. Nothing was deleted.
This folder is the root of the medium. Create a folder named PILI-EXPORT and choose it.
This folder is not on the chosen stick or card. Choose a folder of the same medium.
An order or a takeaway is open. Finish it before exporting.
The engine of the till is not ready. Try again in a moment.
The stick or card is no longer detected. Insert it again.
No folder is chosen on this medium.
The copy of the database or the list of files could not be prepared.
A file could not be written to the medium (full, removed or read-only).
A file of 4 GB or more could not be written: the medium is probably FAT32. Use a medium formatted as exFAT.
A file read back from the medium does not match what was written. The export is invalid: start again with another medium.
A file could not be read (on the till or on the medium).
